learningGoals: Understand the concept of zero (0) as 'nothing' or 'empty'. 🫙
Count objects up to 10 with confidence and accuracy. 🔢
Learn different ways to group and combine smaller numbers to make exactly 10. 🧩
Recognize, read, and write the number 10 correctly. ✍️
teachingTips: Introduce the concept of 'zero' by showing an empty bowl or hands with no items, explaining that zero means 'none'. 🥣
Use everyday household items like beans, buttons, or pebbles to practice counting up to 10 together. 🫘
Show them that 10 is a very special number because it is the first number that uses two digits: 1 and 0! ✨
Encourage them to find groups of 10 around the house, starting with their own 10 fingers and 10 toes. 🖐️

funActivities.title: The Zero Game ⭕
funActivities.description: Hold up a closed fist and say 'zero.' Open your fingers one by one to count to 5, then close them back to zero. Ask your child to show you 'zero' with their hands, an empty plate, or an empty pocket!

funActivities.title: Making 10 with Snacks 🍇
funActivities.description: Give your child 10 grapes or small crackers. Have them split the snacks into two groups (like 6 and 4, or 7 and 3) to see how different combinations always add up to 10 before eating them!

funActivities.title: Ten Toy Parade 🧸
funActivities.description: Ask your child to find and line up exactly 10 of their favorite small toys or blocks in a row. Count them together out loud, pointing to each one to practice one-to-one counting.
